publications.title: Security Vulnerability Assessment Report Splashin iOS Application
publications.description: This report details a comprehensive security assessment of the Splashin iOS application,a platform used for ”Senior Assassin” games that tracks player locations. Our analysisfocused on the premium subscription model and the integrity of location data protectionmechanisms. We identified multiple critical vulnerabilities that allow free-tier users to accesspremium functionality, including real-time location updates and location update requests.This document outlines our methodology, findings, proof-of-concept demonstrations, andrecommendations for remediation. These vulnerabilities pose significant privacy risks tousers and represent a substantial revenue loss opportunity to Splashin’s business model.

projects.title: Mac Messages MCP
projects.description: https://github.com/carterlasalle/mac_messages_mcpDeveloped a Python-based MCP (Model Context Protocol) server that enables secure, programmatic access to the macOS Messages app — integrating message sending, contact filtering, and smart delivery fallback across iMessage and SMS/RCS.🔧 Key Features:• Universal messaging: Seamlessly sends via iMessage or SMS based on recipient availability• Real-time message reading, contact filtering, and fuzzy search• Command-line, module, and LLM-compatible interfaces (Claude + Cursor)• Smart fallback logic for Android recipients• PyPI-published and tested on macOS 11+ with uv package manager• Full disk access logic for secure database integration🛠️ Tech Stack:Python, MCP protocol, AppleScript, macOS internals, GitHub Actions, semantic versioning📦 Available on PyPI • Production-ready as of v0.7.3⭐ 140+ GitHub stars and active community adoption

projects.title: OneCard Scan — Windward Senior Capstone Project
projects.description: https://onecard-capstone.vercel.app/Digitized Student ID Integration for Apple & Google WalletDeveloped a mobile application that enables Windward School students to securely scan and digitize their physical OneCard student ID for seamless use with Apple Wallet and Google Pay. This project, completed as part of Windward’s Senior Capstone Curriculum, was designed to improve daily campus life through practical innovation and student-led development.📲 Key Features:• Optical scanning of student ID cards via phone camera• Automatic extraction of name, ID number, and class year• Generates wallet-compatible passes for iOS and Android• Secure, offline-first design with privacy in mind• Built for scalability across grades and device types🏫 Impact:Rolled out across the Windward community as a first-of-its-kind campus tech utility — simplifying ID use for attendance, events, and check-ins while demonstrating personal growth in engineering, user empathy, and real-world product delivery.🛠️ Tools Used: Python, Gemini Vision API, PassKit, Android Wallet API, iOS Wallet integration, OpenCV

projects.title: Claude Prompt XML Helper
projects.description: Prompt engineering utility for structured XML generation and taggingDesigned and built a web-based assistant to streamline prompt engineering for Anthropic’s Claude models using XML-tagged formatting. This tool enables users to generate well-structured prompt templates with consistent tagging practices and raw CDATA support, improving reproducibility and control in prompt design.🔖 Key Features:• Auto-generates XML blocks from structured inputs• Supports common tags: <instructions>, <context>, <example>, <user_query>, etc.• CDATA support preserves raw characters and nested XML• Customizable root tag and element names• Developer-friendly interface for rapid prototyping💡 Use Case: Helps prompt engineers format and structure inputs for Claude API using best-practice XML syntax.🔗 Hosted version available upon request or for internal tooling integrations

projects.title: Emoji Steganography Encoder
projects.description: https://emojisteg.is-a.devBuilt a web-based tool that encodes and decodes hidden messages inside emoji characters using Unicode variation selectors — demonstrating a novel form of digital steganography. This project explores how visually identical emojis can carry embedded information, offering an engaging way to learn about data encoding, obfuscation, and character-level manipulation.Designed intuitive UI for real-time message encoding/decodingImplemented custom algorithm for byte-to-emoji mappingEmphasized user privacy and educational valueView the open-source project: GitHub – Carter LaSalle

On Monday, Pope Leo XIV released his first encyclical, Magnifica humanitas (Magnificent humanity), which provides moral guidance on safeguarding the human person in the time of AI. We asked six Notre Dame faculty members what they took away from it: https://go.nd.edu/cbdf34

This year at Notre Dame has taught me a valuable lesson about gratitude. It’s been one year since my dream of being admitted into a US university with a full scholarship was fulfilled. And every day, I believe more and more that Notre Dame was the best option for me. The academic level has certainly challenged me, and it is preparing me to become a great businessman who advocates for social good. But beyond that, the university has allowed me to create a new family. Never in my life had I ever met people with aligned ambitions and social concerns who were eager to support me and truly wanted to see me grow, besides my own family. It has been an amazing opportunity to grow my faith with the community and find people equally passionate about social impact and solving problems in the world. Last week, I sat down with Matt B. , a Notre Dame MBA alumnus, in Puerto Vallarta, and within minutes, we were exchanging stories like old friends. That kind of connection still catches me off guard. I am so thankful to this institution and the community for welcoming me with open hearts. Some Alumni from my community, like Carlos Briseno or Juan Carlos Ousset (not pictured), have reunited with me and shared great insights about Notre Dame and life advice, becoming amazing life mentors. Thanks to the incredible culture present at ND, I have been able to form deep connections with alumni and current MBA students from my own hometown, like Patricio Ortiz , whom I approached at the airport because he was wearing Notre Dame merch. He is now one of my closest friends despite being ten years older than me, and I invited him and his wife to have dinner at my house down in Mexico a few weeks ago. Today, I am travelling for free as a part of an academic opportunity brought by ND to practice research and social service in Chile. This is something that young Jonathan would only ever dream of. Often, I get stressed by the daily routine and all the responsibilities coming my way as a young adult, but I am thankful to say that I now have some of the things I dreamed of many years ago. Notre Dame is truly helping me grow as a whole person by getting me closer to great people and nurturing positive values in my soul. I just wanted to share this message with my network to thank you all for being there and to let you know that I am here too, eager to support my community as they support me. I hope to keep working to fulfill my dreams and be there if I can help you fulfill yours. God Bless! Go Irish! ☘️

honors_and_awards.title: AP Scholar with Distinction
honors_and_awards.description: Every fall, the AP Program recognizes high school students who have demonstrated outstanding college-level achievement through their performance on multiple AP Exams. The AP Scholar with Distinction Award is granted to students who receive an average score of at least 3.5 on all AP Exams taken, and scores of 3 or higher on five or more of these exams.
